titles.title: Titles
titles.description: Movie or show names to look up, e.g. Breaking Bad, Inception. Each is searched on JustWatch and the best match is used.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes to check, e.g. US, GB, DE, IN, BR, JP. One output row per title per country.

resultsPerTitle.title: Matches per title
resultsPerTitle.description: How many search matches to include per title (1 = best match only). Raise it when a name is ambiguous, e.g. remakes.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on title x country rows returned. Controls total cost.
